title: Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders: One Fulfillment Method per Order
content:
A customer may place any number of Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders; no limit applies to the number of orders one customer holds. Each order has one fulfillment method for all of its lines.

## Rule

1. Every line on an order is fulfilled by that order's one method.
2. Lines that cannot use the chosen method are placed on a separate order with a method that can carry them. This covers frozen food where the chosen method does not allow frozen food, and large items outside Large Item Freight Delivery.
3. Separate orders are assessed for fees separately: each order number carries its own fulfillment fee assessment.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Condition on the basket | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Every line can use the chosen method | One order is enough | All lines sit on one order under one method |
| A frozen-food line and a method that does not allow frozen food | The line cannot use the method | The frozen-food line goes on a separate order with a method that can carry it |
| A large item and a method other than Large Item Freight Delivery | The line cannot use the method | The large item goes on a separate order with a method that can carry it |

## Worked example (hypothetical basket)

A hypothetical basket holds dry kibble and a frozen raw-food line, and the customer chooses a method that does not allow frozen food. The kibble stays on the order under the chosen method; the frozen line is placed on a second order whose method allows frozen food. The two orders are then each assessed for a fulfillment fee on their own.
